headline: Earnings per share jump sharply from last year
summary_short: EPS was CNY 0.28, up 75% from CNY 0.16 in the prior quarter and up 75% from CNY 0.16 a year earlier.
summary_long: Only the per-share earnings figure is available on the shard. It rose from CNY 0.16 in both the prior quarter and the year-earlier quarter. No revenue, margin or cash figures were available from the shard, and no drivers or guidance are assessed.
